BHU Non Teaching Various Post Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Banaras Hindu University (BHU) has released the notification for the Non Teaching Various Post. This recruitment has been issued for 55 posts. Online applying process for BHU Non Teaching Various Post Recruitment 2026 has started from 25 August 2026 & the candidates can apply till 24 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for BHU Non Teaching Various Post Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 25 August 2026
  • Last Date : 24 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 24 September 2026
  • Send To Hard Copy : Within 07 Days After the Last Date
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • For Group B Posts
  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • All Category Female : 0/-
  • For Group C Posts
  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 250/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
